transkript.t: Your vibe-coded map looks like absolute slop.
Here's how to fix that.
All you need are these three skills.
Number one, the Roblox 3D model skill.
This skill turns models that look like this into this.
Number two, the Roblox map skill.
The previous skill generates the parts.
While this skill ensures that the parts
are actually reachable by players,
it fills in the gaps and hides the signs of AI.
And finally, number three, the Roblox texture skill.
The smallest of the three,
but the one with the most impact,
players can easily spot the signs of AI
just by looking at the textures.
And this skill fixes that.
Your map only looked terrible
because you didn't give your AI the right tools.
Join the Discord, where I give out all these skills for free
and comment anti-slop and I'll send them over to you.
